archive.scope: Pack a complete sealed run with its byte inventory and identities.

arm_campaign.scope: Execute the declared E3–E6 controller-seed studies; the supplied plan identifies paid work and parent runs.

executed_manifest.scope: Extract actual roles, seeds, environment and membership arrays from registered runs.

export_records.scope: Import existing measurements and declared calculations with raw-file locators; never fill them from manuscript targets.

fetch.scope: Retrieve registered public run deposits and verify their pinned archive bytes.

ingest.scope: Verify and register a supplied archive; manuscript relationship remains a separate author declaration.

lifecycle.scope: Execute the registered seven-dataset lifecycle suite and compare supported run outputs with the paper.

model_inventory.scope: Instantiate the released model configurations and count their named parameters.

paper.scope: Download and verify the measured outputs published with the release paper-artifacts, rebuild every numbered table and figure with its source data, and compare every computed value with the printed one.

requires: Completed reported runs, record sets and campaigns on the cluster
publish.scope: Upload the packed outputs of the reported runs, record sets, campaigns and environment to the release paper-artifacts, record their SHA-256 in release/paper_artifacts.json, download them back, verify them, rebuild every display and write the split/seed manifests, observed environments and source data to commit.

requires: Registered original or reproduced run archives
reconstruct.scope: Build supported numerical outputs and enumerate the scope of every numbered display.

reconstruction_example.scope: Build the unified report using bundled synthetic observations; no benchmark measurements are implied.

record_check.scope: Recheck record-set file hashes and trace each summary value to its source.

registered_design.scope: Write prescribed split/seed/configuration manifests; these describe the design.

registry_check.scope: Check reported reference values, protocol constants and recorded PDF identities within their stated scope.

scientific_audit.scope: Check original experiment bindings, joint confirmation, budget and auxiliary evidence within the enumerated audit scope.

si.scope: Recompute supplementary relationships from printed inputs with precision and interpretation notes.

statement_check.scope: Evaluate each item of the registered availability statement against the repository and the published manifest.

requires: Original S14 family for confirmation outputs
supplement.scope: Build supported factorial, joint-confirmation, ensemble-fit and arm-comparison outputs from validated inputs.

synthetic_suite.scope: Exercise the launcher on synthetic data; outputs remain synthetic.

theory.scope: Run numerical checks of the stated analytical implications; these are not experimental observations.

requires: Reviewed pinned upstream code and plan
upstream_baseline.scope: Execute one declared pinned-upstream HPO attempt; selection and final-seed phases follow the baseline guide.

verify.scope: Check implementation, sealed examples, source references and generated artifacts.

generated.scope: A new suite records its executed lifecycles; separate auxiliary drivers have their own inputs and outputs.

entries.scope: Core and auxiliary experiment implementations are included; release/experiment_code.json maps every experiment behind a reported display to its code, command and outputs.
entries.title: Experimental implementation

generated.scope: Each executed run, including each Roman-empire split, records its resolved runtime configuration.

The Slurm launcher freezes submitted/resolved configuration, environment settings and source hashes once per dataset run or Roman-empire campaign; the ten Roman split runs use that shared campaign snapshot.

entries.scope: Smoke, pilot and full profiles plus portable site templates. Model counts identify released configurations; original checkpoint identity requires the associated run.
entries.title: Configurations

generated.scope: Prepared arrays are produced from provider data or explicitly synthetic input; source hashes and raw-data policy accompany the run.

entries.scope: Official provider data, reported numerical references and experimental observations have separate identities. The source data of every display is generated from the published measured outputs (paper/source_data/, written by the publication step); transcribed values never become reconstructed measurements.
entries.title: Source data and reported values

generated.scope: Role membership and graph/core units are recorded where applicable.
Executed manifests contain actual memberships and seed identities; these differ from prescribed design manifests.

entries.scope: Registered manifests prescribe splits/seeds; manifests/published/ records the memberships and seeds that every published run used. Membership and optimization-seed evidence stay separate.
entries.title: Split and seed manifests

generated.scope: Package, device and runtime observations are recorded for each execution.

entries.scope: Released lock files and containers specify environments; each run carries its actual execution environment, and environment/observed/ summarizes it for every published run.
entries.title: Environment specifications

generated.scope: Weights, parameter inventory and freeze audits are products of that run.

entries.scope: The checkpoints of the reported runs are assets of the release paper-artifacts (complete tier; release/paper_artifacts.json). Bundled checkpoint files are synthetic examples.
entries.title: Trained checkpoints and model inventories

generated.scope: Predictions remain bound to the frozen policies, statistical units, membership and evaluator.

entries.scope: The predictions of the reported runs are assets of the release paper-artifacts (complete tier); paired observations are in the analysis tier. Numerical agreement with a manuscript value does not establish that a new run produced the original paper.
entries.title: Predictions and paired observations

generated.scope: Behavior probabilities, actions, trajectory groups and support diagnostics must remain attached to the same observations.

entries.scope: The propensity-logged exploration trajectories of the reported runs are assets of the release paper-artifacts (both tiers); bundled synthetic examples show the format.
entries.title: Exploration and propensity logs

generated.scope: Local per-run inference is distinct from the original cross-dataset nine-test S14 family.
Measurement records are imported from supplied original or reproduced observations and retain their provenance.
The evidence audit writes its enumerated checks and limitations for the registered inputs.
Only outputs supported by the supplied evidence are emitted; statistical import does not invent original unrounded test outputs.

entries.scope: Statistical code and arithmetic checks are included; the selection, confirmation, admission and evaluation records of every reported run and every record set and campaign behind a display are assets of the release paper-artifacts.
entries.title: Statistical analyses

generated.scope: The unified report enumerates every display and states which outputs were built, partially built or only checked.
